heroHeadline: Supreme Court refuses HPEC reconstitution — orders pellet gun and security excess enquiry before any committee changes
heroSubtitle: NLSIU's Executive Council and General Council, meeting Sep 9, set October 17, 2026 as the new date for the 34th Annual Convocation it had cancelled outright on Aug 27 amid student and alumni objection to Chief Justice Surya Kant's planned attendance. The university's Alumni Association Governing Board said it engaged in 'sustained dialogue' with stakeholders including the CJI himself and cited an 'overwhelming' majority of the Batch of 2026 wanting a formal ceremony rather than in-absentia conferral alone — but neither statement confirms whether Surya Kant will actually attend, leaving the underlying boycott dispute unresolved even as the cancellation is reversed. The Jharkhand BJP's statewide siege, the CJP/CJP-Democratic split, Bihar's TRE-4 process (exam window Sep 22-27) and the Jamia admissions dispute remain unchanged since their early-September developments.
